topics.topic: Required outcome when concurrent progress reads race to create the singleton manual budget version
questions: When concurrent authorized reads of one archived project both observe that no manual version exists, must both reads succeed using one resulting version, or may one be refused by the uniqueness or persistence race?

When concurrent staff progress reads race to create the project's sole manual budget version, must every read succeed using the one resulting version, or may a losing read fail with a persistence/conflict error?

When concurrent progress reads race to create the sole manual BudgetVersion, must every caller succeed by converging on the one version, or may a losing caller receive a uniqueness/persistence failure?

judgement.why: This is the same concurrent lazy manual-version creation race already judged in P20, and the relevant passages have not changed.

precedent.topic: Required outcome of concurrent progress reads racing to create the manual budget version
quotes:
A18: at most one manual version per project; a new one is `inactive` and is
never activated implicitly; A13 (`budget.manual_version_create` only when it
is created).
precedent.why: State 5 enforces uniqueness through persistence and permits a racing request to fail because the resulting persistence failure propagates rather than being retried or converted into success.

topics.topic: Whether archived-project progress reads may create the lazy manual budget version despite the active-project mutation guard
questions: Does list_project_progress bypass the active-project requirement when its read creates the first manual budget version for an archived project, or must the guard refuse that creation?
Does the archived-project lazy manual-budget creation override PLAT-REG-003, or must the active-only linked-mutation invariant still reject it?

Is the manual-budget creation performed by an archived-project progress read an explicit exception to PLAT-REG-003, or must the read avoid or refuse that write because Registry did not report the project active?

judgement.why: This is the same question about authorization of the archived-project exception already judged in P13, and the relevant passages have not changed.

precedent.topic: Authorization of implicit manual-version creation during archived-project progress reads
quotes:
The one write that is not refused for an archived project
is the empty manual budget version (with its audit) that
`ensure_manual_budget` creates, also when `list_project_progress` reads a
project that has none.

Not a pure read: when the project has no manual budget version, this list
creates it empty with its `budget.manual_version_create` audit, exactly as
`ensure_manual_budget` does, an archived project included; otherwise
read-only.
precedent.why: State 5 explicitly authorizes the archived project as a read and permits the exceptional manual-version write and audit.

topics.topic: Whether lazy BudgetVersion persistence makes list_project_progress a committing mutation path and how failure translation applies
questions: For A6, is list_project_progress classified by its read API semantics or by the fact that it persists a BudgetVersion, and where is its exception to the archived_project translation applied?
Is list_project_progress a committing write path when it lazily creates the manual budget version, or must it follow the read-path rollback rule?

quotes:
The tracking read transaction closes before
`budget_management.ensure_manual_budget` is called for the order.

Not a pure read: when the project has no manual budget version, this list
creates it empty with its `budget.manual_version_create` audit, exactly as
`ensure_manual_budget` does, an archived project included; otherwise
read-only.

Reads of an archived project succeed; every mutation
  of its records and every new staff assignment for it is
  `ArchivedProjectRejected`; a new viewer grant for it is refused with the
  `RegistryBoundaryError` its operation names; revocation consults no
  Registry (R0-24). The one write that is not refused for an archived project
  is the empty manual budget version (with its audit) that
  `ensure_manual_budget` creates, also when `list_project_progress` reads a
  project that has none.
judgement.why: State 5 explicitly separates and closes the tracking read transaction before invoking the committing ensure operation, permits that write for archived projects, and propagates any persistence failure.
